text: announces himself as "The King of Destruction, Flos"
once conquered a continent, then his empire collapsed; he sleeps
speaks through twinTrouble_53, declares his return and warns Wistram
King of Destruction; asleep ten years in his capital; mages listed him eighth likeliest disaster; 30 percent chance he conquers the world
conquered nearly all of Chandrar and landed armies on Izril's southern shores before vanishing
King of Destruction; golden-red hair; about six years older looking than when Gazi left; a decade of conquest then a decade asleep
quotes lines from Ozymandias, which the twins taught him; wishes to meet its poet
learns that creating something never before made grants a skill automatically
vows to kill the Emperor of Sands and calls his Seven to war
King of Destruction; sat in the dream with Drevish, Amerys, Gazi, Orthenon and Takhatres the night before a battle
has slept in the same bed for the last twenty years and wakes at dawn by habit
cannot hold the dream; he remembers the block of ice on the table and weeps for six minutes, then dresses and strides out as a King
eats while walking; likes bacon rolls the twins introduced, now a permanent castle food
admits he hesitates because he fears war and may lack the stomach for it
says he slept twenty years and fears the cost of war; he is a King whose class and nature pursue war
Mars's gift brooch (yellow gem) disguises the wearer as a common person (hazel eyes, grey-flecked dark hair, slightly shorter); lasts several hours and is toggled by touching the gem
says Orthenon would see through the illusion and Gazi could even without her main eye
carried five heavy sacks at once and helped unload a [Trader]'s wagon in his disguise
tells Trey and Teres he leaves logistics to Orthenon by saying "Orthenon, take care of it" without please
hit Trey hard in sparring with a real unenchanted sword; Trey's shield held but he was knocked flat
tells Trey he meant the blow to change gossip so the twins would be seen to have blocked a King
sends yellow-bottled healing potion to the twins; his own is clear blue
throws the twins off his balcony to escape the palace unseen, then takes them by horse; neither can ride
banner is a black flag stitched with gold around the edges and a flame of gold, silver, white and purple
calls himself a bad King and admits to the twins he has not been a King since waking
tells Manimar he claimed them long ago, asks them to follow him one last time and they pledge; villagers recognise him by torchlight
said in youth that he can't be killed by [Assassins] because a vassal (Gazi) guards him, and his dream "as large as all of Chandrar" makes him unbeatable
one year after the first meeting led a force of a few hundred amateur soldiers against the Black Judgment after learning a child's name (Merisa)
sword was plain unenchanted steel, bent by blows and broken by Venith's shield
punches Venith's shield, kicks him, headbutts him and knocks him out with a fist cut on the helm's faceguard
tells Orthenon "Take care of it. Please"
poem about the forges and the King awoke, made as a boy for his mother
was a low-level [Prince] of a tiny kingdom; his father had little time for him; his mother had faith in him
in the flashback abandoned his reign after Queravia and Tottenval were found dead, saying "The King of Destruction is no more"
asked the twins to refuse any class offered until sure of their choice; he thinks Teres suits [Warrior] better than Trey
deliberately splits the twins; Teres tells him the truth and stands up to him in his wrath, Trey understands how he thinks
has the vassals Orthenon, Mars, Gazi and Maresar drill the army; the army has some old veterans armed with gear Mars obtained but too few and very low-level recruits
has the twins describe Earth daily over foods the cooks imitate (Yorkshire pudding, black pudding); servants barred from the room for objecting to the twins using his name
believes the world has an edge where the sea pours into blackness; only one or two ships in a thousand return; islanders on an archipelago nearest it say things sometimes come from there
admires Gandhi, dismisses Alexander, Arthur and Churchill; calls Hitler a great leader but "not worthy" of a King's title; hates guns; says he could defeat a gun army two ways
secret of rulers: the more classes one has the lower the level reachable; some classes (Lord, King) have stronger Skills than single-purpose ones
says the land fades when its King abandons it, and refuses a war of greed; he will wage war for a child or a fallen comrade
uses the Skill [Rapid March] (army moves twice as fast); has used it since Reim; the crowd covers over 24 miles in about four hours
leads thousands around Rast's walls shouting "Flos!" every fourth step and the people inside open the gates
the gods are dead
takes the city of Rast without a battle by walking round its walls, saying afterward that it was "perhaps a metaphor"
says Treland was a fool and a monster who treated his subjects worse than animals, and that he went to war for the thousands who died under his rule
Calliope has seen war once and Flos would not ransom her son
Reim has just over six thousand soldiers (6,256), perhaps two thousand more from refugees; each enemy nation sent about ten thousand
his Seven are Mars, Gazi, Takhatres, Drevish, Amerys, Tottenval and Queravia; Tottenval and Queravia died in the war
largest army he saw was over four hundred thousand; at his peak he had three armies over a hundred thousand; a Goblin King's army is a million or more
opens storehouses and rides out of Reim with Trey and Teres to save slaughtered refugees; Mars cannot disobey a King's order to stay
kills a dozen mounted raiders with his sword; calls "This is my world. See it with your own two eyes." to the twins
forms refugees, mostly elderly retired warriors, into a "[Royal Vanguard]" charge of about sixty riders; their kills astonish Trey
the ambushers are soldiers not raiders; a [Leader] with Skills commands them; the [Mage] in bright yellow robes strikes the earth every fourth step
I have one Skill I could use. If this were an army. But it is not.
orders a [Message] to Roshal and the Traders for food and supplies using captives; Gazi calls the Traders "Slavers"
sells captives from the battle for Reim to the Traders of Roshal for coin and food, some ransomed; he says slavery is part of Chandrar and equates it to Earth's imprisonment
King of Destruction on his throne in Chandrar; Orthenon is his advisor; Flos wishes he had met the Goblin King; asks that Trey and Teres be taught about him; rats that teleport in granaries
rides with Teres, Trey and Gazi to a mining town to have a new sword made
King of Destruction, red-gold hair, fully Human, over forty, one of the highest-level [Kings], Skills geared to war
slumbered for over a decade after giving up conquest until two humans from Earth appeared; woke and recalled his vassals
after crushing a coalition army at Reim he conquered Germina and Hellios in under two weeks before winter
beheads the Quarass in her throne room after she sends a [Mage] to kill him
eats Yellats stew, considered a poor man's food, and likes simple fare
gave away his sword, armor, helmet, lance and rings including a [Ring of Health] from Armil's treasury
carries 10,000 gold in a bag of holding taken from the Quarass's treasury
told Dwarves paid for arms but they delivered only Gazi's armor and sword, a masterwork
addresses the world through a scrying orb, claims the Empire of Sands as foe, demands Wistram return Amerys
publicly announces his return and offers amnesty to nations that do not attack him
killed the Quarass in the Palace (Seat of Ger) about a month earlier; coalition army was routed at Reim by Drevish's tower lightning, and unredeemed prisoners were sold to a Trader of Roshal
drops the illusion before the crowd, swears on his Seven and crown to protect her, and claims Germina for forty years
freezes the crowd with "Halt", offers the Quarass an alliance; she accepts "By Ger's waters" and agrees to stop child [Assassins] but keeps her adult ones
Skill [The Choice of the Conquered] makes those who would never accept him flee; a few hundred left Ger; Maresar to hunt them, captives preferred
says Teres's Earth proves gods once existed and are now dead; thinks faith is the difference between the worlds
plans against Earth's weapons, e.g. a [Pyromancer] disabling combustion and Stitch-People made of kevlar; Teres told him of tanks, nukes and Mach 9 aircraft
ride to Blalevault takes a day with his Skill; Belchan is eight days' march north of it; Takhatres is harassing the Empire of Sands
says he has killed about twenty-three rulers
returns at sundown with about eight wagons of gold and artifacts; Nawal calls the legends true
has Daiton's pattern-welded sword and Nawal's enchanted blade shown; Daiton's is fine but ordinary, Nawal's survives a one-handed sledgehammer blow on a ten-brick bridge unharmed
Naq-Alrama sword is "a mage-killer"; he wants a spear for Orthenon, blades for Takhatres, a sword for himself; his old sword was enchanted
the Seven also included Drevish, Queravia and Tottenval; Tottenval, a Beastkin [Gardener] from Baleros, died at sea saving Flos's life
Queravia and he were close; his cup dented when Trey raised it; Queravia once led armies alongside Orthenon
says Amerys is held by Wistram, perhaps by three Archmages, and has not answered his [Message]; he still trusts her

Skills include edicts (only one active at a time): [Edict of Bloom] (faster crops, healing and births, six-month pregnancies, monsters and hunger as cost), [Edict of Silversky] (calm weather, lies hard to tell), [Edict of the Bloo
decides to issue the [Edict of Bloom] next day
[Blessing of Rains] is a monarch Skill type, one active at a time; units like [Driftwind Riders] and [Steelshorn Relentless] need conditions such as about a hundred enchanted blades
took gold and artifacts from Germina's and Hellios's treasuries for his officers

map of nations threatening Reim: Khelt (west, ruled by Fetohep, undead army), Belchan (mage school), Jecrass (King Raelt), Tiqr (Garuda, war elephants, only possible ally, an Empress), Nerrhavia's Fall, Pomle, Savere, Illivere, Th
issues a world-wide declaration of peace backed by an "or else"; the message was the prelude to war
reads the article and watches rain, recalling a girl riding an elephant
explains Skills scale with level, e.g. [Deft Hand] for [Ladies] and [Power Strike]; vowed not to make war without just cause so cannot aid Tiqr
burned all pictures of Queravia because they could not capture her; Tottenval and Queravia were two of his Seven
orders Mars back from the south to intercept, Gazi with Serpent Hunters and Parasol Stroll to join, no casualties; messenger is Finl Ulesey, born in Hellios
refuses Nsiia's request; per Nsiia he told her to wait and live until he returns Tiqr to itself
tells the Quarass that Trey and Teres are from another world and the reason he returned; she says she has never heard of that in any lifetime
the Quarass agrees to intercede with Fetohep (Khelt) in exchange for his reasons; Flos had planned to tell her anyway
swore by the Shield Kingdoms, Germina's soil and Ger's Oasis to shed his blood before the Quarass's
wears plate armor, uses [Rapid March] to move the party at about double speed, leads the [Royal Vanguard] cavalry
guesses Fetohep wants a blood-sworn vow of non-interference and senses Reim's weakness
tells the twins he could not help Tiqr and swears to return it
waits at the Khelt border at midday with Gazi, Serpent Hunters and Parasol Stroll; says he sent Trey because Gazi took him as a pupil and he is kind and listens
agree Khelt gives Reim thirty thousand bushels of food per month for eight years in exchange for Flos's blood oath never to take arms against Khelt
took four thousand Kheltian volunteers in his first war, which Fetohep resents
watches refugees return to Reim from his balcony with Orthenon and Gazi; a Rustängmarder company of about a hundred and the half-Giant Nomads of the Sky have arrived
wants vassals, artifacts and a Naq-Alrama blade from Nawalishifra; received a message of inquiry from a potential ally
orders Orthenon to hold on asking the Iron Vanguard how much they would charge to take Wistram, after Gazi offers a cheaper idea
the King of Destruction watches with Gazi the Omniscient; says Amerys could not break Zeres, orders Trey, Teres and Mars summoned, and demands Archmage Feor give Amerys back
gained [Army of the King] at Level 50, believed usable only once every so often; he has sworn peace, lost Tiqr to keep his oath, and demands free passage to Reim for anyone claiming loyalty
shouts his title, makes Jecrass' army and mounts kneel by aura, and Raelt resists it with "Steady"; he rides with Orthenon and Mars the Illusionist
green eyes, red-gold hair, no grey; asks to cross Jecrass, buy a magical horse, and finally asks Raelt to vassalise, offering Hellios; Raelt refuses all and lies that Jecrass has no Pegasus
says he swore eternal war on the Empire of Sands and will behead its [Emperor]
gives Raelt a rubik's cube made by one of his vassals; Raelt places it in his quarters
a six-thousand-strong caravan of refugees from Jecrass approaches, led by Gnolls with Lizardfolk
claims Reim's army is only for protection and exercise
mentions Trey, Gazi and the Quarass travelling by magic carpet
Skill [A Kingdom's Strength] at Level 30 makes him stronger than his Seven, and he lifts fifteen pounds one-handed
says without artifacts he is only about Gold-rank, hates flying foes, wall spells and mental attacks; his shield's burst is slow
grants the Gnolls land from Hellios' stone mountains to Reim, and a castle; says Tottenval, a Beastkin of the Fox Tribe, died at sea saving his life
beheads the [Headman], Belchan [Commander] and officers on live broadcast, then declares war on Belchan and Lyfelt
stands at the front of his army with broadsword and shield and kills a [Lineholder] cleaving through his tower shield
swore to kill Prime Minister Lyfelt; demands Belchan's politicians, officers and leaders be executed; Teres is determined to stop slaughter of citizens
throws weapons including a Returning Javelin and hatchet; breaks Raelt's ribs and leg and throws him through the stone wall
orders a retreat rather than use his [Army of the King]; laughs and calls Raelt a worthy foe
says King Raelt is honorable and brave and fought Orthenon personally that morning, but Reim opposes him because he sheltered the Prime Minister and is backed by Flos's enemies
after Raelt's duel Raelt levelled; Flos says he levelled too and activates [The King's Architect], summoning a memory of Drevish who tells him the city's name is bad
gains Skill [The King's Architect]
the King of Destruction plays football with Mars and Orthenon on the Wistram broadcast; Mars appears dusky-skinned and Teres is present
sends Joseph a [Message] asking for the rules; Typhenous has Joseph sign cardboard memorabilia
survives by smashing a healing potion into the wound and pulling the rapier out; kills Winta; Emile dies; Commander Ytol of the Rustängmarder offers deaths
wants to provoke Medain into war then hit the Claiven Earth, and fears half-Elves melded into trees
marches by [Rapid March] toward Medain claiming to demand Jecaina's return
his past war with Minotaurs included a sea ambush that nearly destroyed his fleets; Tottenval the Gardener's sacrifice saved him
tells Teres the Minotaurs once attacked him at sea after he avoided them, and he will return the favor
orders Orthenon back from battle to flank the Minotaurs; recognizes Ozem's armor from the sea battle

uses [Army of the King] when Teres falls; his soldiers and Teres gain levels, Teres becoming a temporary Level 35 Trained Bladeswoman with Shadowcut Blade, Acrobat's Form, Keening Edge and Enhanced Strength
his Skill will be unavailable for a crucial month
orders Takhatres recalled from the campaign against the Empire of Sands to safeguard borders
calm and silent on the march; says the last time this many nations declared on him was when he unified most of Chandrar
orders Mars to give spare magical blades to Ytol for the Sorcelled Blades unit, which Orthenon will lead as roaming cavalry
gives the Nomads of the Sky to Ytol for Reim, sends Mars north against Claiven Earth and Medain, and keeps Esiela (under blood-oath) near him
orders Mars, Orthenon and the Nomads to take a border city of Medain without killing civilians
swears to kill Prime Minister Lyfelt and to offer Raelt's daughter one chance to meet Raelt's terms before taking Jecrass's capital

her rings and cloak were drained, and the Gnolls and Drakes took the ones with power left
hates half-Elves and fears the dead, calls Ceria a "freak" and Erin a [Necromancer]
steals most of Erin's gold (not what was hidden under the floorboards) and flees north
gains a level as a [Barmaid]

watches Erin and Ryoka from the stairs

[Princess] aged eighteen, heir to a Terandrian kingdom

crossed from Terandria to Izril, survived monsters and the mob that expelled her from Liscor

gains [Barmaid] level and [Basic Cooking]

serves Pawn, her first paying customer, and resolves to run the inn

rejoicing at no longer being alone and at honest work
[Carer] and [Tactician] classes; says Terandria's rulers gain classes by influencing people; royal, rare and merged classes are stronger; a [Princess] can grant unique classes
[Beast Tamer] Level 1 with [Healthy Rearing] for caring for the bee grub, which she may name
banned from Liscor; has about a year for four years since leveling [Princess]; family has secrets about classes

runs the inn while Erin and Ryoka are away; cooks poorly, has blistered hands from scrubbing

casts [Light] that turns green and grows; the inn's walls glow and shake

bakes bread using Erin's baking powder
overhears Erin cry "I want to go home" and swears an oath on her name and blood
swears to help Erin go home
Level 3 [Beast Tamer], Level 4 [Carer], Level 9 [Barmaid], Level 5 [Princess]; tends Apista

eighteen years old; had only one Skill from [Princess] in her life
uses dried blue-fruit seed cores to scare away Rock Crabs; has done so twice

screams at Erin that Toren pushed her into Shield Spider nests, hit her and abandoned her, then runs out

secretly identified as a [Princess] by Ryoka and appointed head of staff by Erin

first level as [Princess] and Warrior; learns tips flow to her

throw lightning, thorn, tripvine, pepper, fire, Silverfrost potions at the goats
spanks Mrsha after the wand attack; earlier punishes Mrsha with no lunch
can make [Knights] with a few words; royally appoints a business; grants Krshia "my royal favor" in the ritual
runaway [Princess] who fears her family would send someone after her; not a First Princess

capture two Pallass Watch who charged through, when the door went dead behind them

[Barmaid] Level 15, [Warrior] Level 4, gets [Balanced Posture]
loses [Princess] class, losing [Detect Poison] and [Royal Tax]
begins weeping uncontrollably the next morning, lying that nothing happened
says she was only Level 6 as a [Princess] and had two Skills
suggests crafts, tag, communal living space; Pawn buys knitting needles, yarn, balls, clay
tells Pawn she lost [Princess] because she stopped living like one and says she is glad
confronts Pawn, tears up, shouts at him not to pray for her, runs upstairs
waltzes from years of court training; the Antinium waltz in pairs with Purple Smile teaching
believes part of her wanted to lose the class to be someone else
class restored overnight as [Worldly Princess] Level 11; [Warrior], [Barmaid], [Beast Tamer], [Tactician], [Carer] consolidated into it
gains [Basic Crafting], [Weapon Proficiency: Sword], [Basic Negotiator], [Basic Leadership], [Flawless Attempt]
next day they hold hands and agree to find out if it is love
new Skill [Flawless Attempt] does what she does at her best, with a cooldown; she made Mrsha an omelette

plans to take Mrsha to Celum with Bird as bodyguard

uses her aura on Erin in argument; Erin pushes it back
seen by her father the King in a scrying pool; he wants her brought back
[Barmaid] who keeps a plain steel sword by her
cracked, bleeding hands from soap; remembers hand creams from the kingdom's [Court Alchemist]; admits she wants to be a [Princess] again
Sixth in service to the Eternal Throne of Calanfer, which dates about six thousand years
built a wooden wheel carrying the mana stones so the door can switch destinations
takes over management of the inn while Erin travels
reveals she is a [Princess] to Numbtongue and Mrsha

sends Apista with notes to Krshia for eggs
reaches [Worldly Princess] Level 17 and gains [Apista: Enhanced Intelligence], [Apista: Agile Flier] and [Imperial Aura]

tells Erin there are two cakes and ice cream ingredients for eight guests; ice is expensive
hold hands to supervise the third floor works; Archer B19 thanks Erin for soup and chess

granted Liscor citizenship; Numbtongue offered a provisional entry permit

[Princess] who uses [Flawless Attempt] to make a near-perfect veggie burger
stops Erin from chasing the thief herself and tells her to call the Watch
talks Erin into negotiating, arguing Calanfer survived thousands of years by making allies, and that Erin needs an ally in Wistram
wants to remodel the inn; Erin delays Belgrade by one week; the Antinium have tripled the hill's size

funded the build from Liscor's payment, Creler attack money and Erin's savings; hopes for Gold-rank teams as guests
uses an aura to silence the inn, as does Zevara; Erin can resist both inside her own inn
gives her name as Lyon at the meeting
effective day-to-day manager of the inn, with Erin as the superior-ranked but trusted subordinate
says she ran away from home; the Calanfer royals have her double; her father and mother probably do not care; sending a [Message] would cause trouble
usually takes a potion against menstruation as does her family; says her own bleeding is bad and she may return to potions now Octavia is there
have sex in her room using a harness bought from Krshia, planned for a month, against Klbkch's orders
begin a sexual relationship

keep their relationship secret; Mrsha knows from the scent and sulks

calls herself "Lyon" to Veeid

gains Level 20 and the Skill [Boon of the Princess]

is dating Pawn; Erin knows, Ryoka learns it and promises silence
teaches Mrsha etiquette; her "Lessons From Home" cover riots

has had Belgrade and Pawn undo a two-floor stables; "hired" eighteen unpainted Antinium Workers from Bird's crew as labour
nearly paid off her fine from Zevara from her own income

father is King of Calanfer with [Favor of the King], powering Calanfer's Champion of the Dawn
gives the [Boon of the Princess] to Numbtongue and promises Bird it tomorrow
is hiring eight staff from 37 applicants, hopes to add four Antinium; Ishkr's sister Liska is hired
dreams of the early inn, the first Painted Antinium (white paw print), and Zel Shivertail as her first real guest; wakes jealous that Mrsha slept with Ryoka

missing since the morning gathering plants; no tracks found
does not speak though her throat is undamaged; makes yelps and growls; light brown fur

points the way with her paw
her brown fur turns pure white

white fur now like snow, brown eyes, silent; her tribe's death was the price
alternates between two and four legs
only the second Human she has met is Erin (Ryoka the first)
bites Erin's ankle and claws her; Erin throws her off
eats Erin's sausage and eggs, then crepes with a fork Erin teaches her to use
bites Brunkr and Erin punches him into a wall
stays at the inn

stays at the inn with Lyonette
